learning_outcomes.description: Interact effectively with other exercise professionals and demonstrate effective written and oral communication skills relevant to the profession
Contribute to the efficient operation of a community, private or government based health and fitness setting or athlete performance environment
Interpret health and fitness assessments, and offer creative solutions to achieve clients' health and fitness goals

Demonstrate the ability to use research skills to critically evaluate specific areas of assessment, client centred interventions and/or education to determine whether research evidence indicates that current practice should be maintained or modified
Develop scientific rationale for professional decision making and service delivery; appropriate time management; and ability to work collaboratively, and independently (as appropriate)
Demonstrate professional conduct that is sensitive to client diversity and equity, and is consistent with the ESSA Code of Professional Conduct and Ethical Practice

assessments.due_date: 5:00 pm on the Friday of your third week of placement.
assessments.task_description:
To meet ESSA Practicum Standards during your placement, a logbook must be kept detailing all relevant practicum hours. A minimum of 140 hours of practicum is required across a range of exercise science activities to demonstrate competency in assessment, prescription, and delivery within the Accredited Exercise Scientist (AES) scope of practice.

Practicum hours must be completed with at least 80 hours assessment, prescription and delivery. The 80 hours are not required to be evenly split across assessment, prescription, and delivery activities. Additionally, up to 60 hours undertaking any other activities that reflect the AES scope of practice.

assessments.task_description:
As student practitioners on practicum, you are required to critically reflect on your performance and self-assess your developing capabilities. This self-assessment supports your

development as a reflective practitioner, a key capability embedded within the ESSA Professional Practice Standards. You will assess yourself against the ESSA Professional

Standards based on your experiences from the first half of your placement.
assessments.submission_guidelines: Click the submission link on Blackboard to access the self-reflection form in ePortfolio. Complete all required sections of the form, including the written reflection responses and self-ratings against the relevant professional attributes.

assessments.late_submission: You will receive a mark of 0 if this assessment is submitted late.

assessments.due_date: 5:00 pm on the Friday of your third week of placement.
assessments.task_description:
As student practitioners on practicum, you are required to receive structured feedback on your developing professional capabilities. At the mid-point of your placement, your

supervisor will assess your performance against the ESSA Professional Standards and provide ratings and commentary based on your progress to date. The purpose of this

assessment is to support your development as a reflective practitioner, guide professional growth, and identify strengths and areas requiring further improvement during the

remainder of your placement.
assessments.submission_guidelines: Students are responsible for generating the correct assessment link in ePortfolio and sending it to their supervisor. Students must also organise a suitable time to meet with theirsupervisor to discuss and complete the assessment. Detailed instructions for generating and sharing the link are provided on Blackboard. The supervisor is responsible forcompleting and submitting the assessment form in ePortfolio.

assessments.late_submission: You will receive a mark of 0 if this assessment is submitted late.
assessments.additional_info: You may be able to apply for an extension.

assessments.due_date: 5:00 pm, 14 calendar days after your placement completion date
assessments.task_description: At the end of your placement, your supervisor will conduct a Final Professional Attributes Assessment to evaluate your overall performance and readiness for professionalpractice. This assessment uses the same four-point scale applied throughout your placement. This final assessment provides an opportunity for you and your supervisor toreview your performance, acknowledge strengths, identify any remaining areas for development, and confirm that you have met the minimum professional competency requiredfor successful course completion. Unlike theProfessional Attributes Intermediate Assessment, the Professional Attributes Final Assessment is summative and contributes toyour overall course result. To pass the placement, you must meet or exceed expectations in all Standards.

assessments.task_description:
To demonstrate that you have met the ESSA Practicum Standards during your placement, you are required to complete and submit a Record of Student Engagement Form. The

Record of Student Engagement provides a structured summary of the activities you undertook during placement, drawing on evidence contained in your practicum logbooks, and

a reflective account of how your placement contributed to the development of the ESSA professional attributes required for accreditation. The Record of Student Engagement

must be completed using the ESSA-approved template and must be reviewed and signed by your practicum supervisor.
